purpose: Manufacturer/package-only source-bound draft assertions for the seven existing canonical skincare Product IDs. Preparation artifact only; not accepted ProductKnowledge, not a Product Master import, and not permission to write to a live database.
rules: Use only official manufacturer disclosures and information printed on the physical product package. No retailer, analyst-inference, independent-study or external-clinical-literature assertions are included.
Every assertion remains qa_status=PENDING, evidence_status=UNKNOWN and evidence_strength=UNVERIFIED until the existing authorized human Evidence QA workflow is used.
Manufacturer statements, including any manufacturer-reported test result, must remain explicitly labeled MANUFACTURER_CLAIM and must never be presented as independently verified efficacy.
The Product Owner has confirmed the seven physical product identities. This manifest does not reopen identity confirmation or authorize new Product records.
Market/formula-specific manufacturer web pages are source snapshots only; do not silently transfer a different market or version's INCI, percentages, directions or claims to a package.
No contraindication is inferred from ingredient presence, fragrance, or absence of a warning. Use only explicit package warnings; otherwise contraindications remain unknown/unreviewed.
No ingredient-role or efficacy mapping is inferred by the analyst. Keep ingredient_roles unknown unless the manufacturer explicitly states the role.
COSRX scope is only The 6 Peptide Skin Booster Serum. All other COSRX products are excluded.
The existing Anua records are left untouched. This manifest does not perform cleanup, reclassification, duplicate resolution or new Anua Evidence intake.
No database writes, QA promotion, lifecycle changes, inventory changes, ProductProblemLink creation or Recommendation activation are performed by this artifact.

products.identity: COSRX The 6 Peptide Skin Booster Serum; 150 ml research target

assertions.claim: The manufacturer positions the booster for the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, loss of firmness, uneven tone, rough texture, visible pores and radiance, and describes hydration/skin-conditioning benefits. These are manufacturer cosmetic claims, not a treatment indication.

The official manufacturer page lists the peptide ingredients Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, Copper Tripeptide-1, sh-Polypeptide-121, Dipeptide Diaminobutyroyl Benzylamide Diacetate, Oligopeptide-68 and Palmitoyl Tripeptide-8, and also highlights niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, N-acetylglucosamine and allantoin. This is a source-page ingredient snapshot, not verification of the physical 150 ml package or a complete current INCI.
Manufacturer positioning: skin conditioning/booster use with moisture, texture and radiance claims. These are cosmetic positioning statements, not a validated treatment indication.

The manufacturer reports +162.5% deep moisture, +76.4% texture, +40.1% clarity, +24.5% radiance and +22.2% density based on 20 subjects at Dermacosmetic Skin Science Laboratory Co., Ltd, 2023-09-18 to 2023-10-31. Full protocol, comparator, instruments, analysis and independent replication are not available in the reviewed public page; treat all figures as manufacturer-reported only.
Manufacturer directions: use after cleansing as a toner/booster, pat a few drops over the face, then follow with ampoule, serum or moisturizer. The physical package directions remain authoritative.

products.identity: Neutrogena Clear & Defend 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash; 200 ml
identity_limits: UK is the research source market only; physical target market and formula match UNKNOWN
Package INCI and warnings not verified

assertions.claim: The UK manufacturer positions this 2% salicylic acid wash for spot-prone/oily skin and says it helps prevent future breakouts and supports a smoother, clearer-looking complexion. This is manufacturer positioning, not a guaranteed acne outcome.

UK manufacturer-page INCI snapshot: Aqua, Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine, Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate, Glycerin, Salicylic Acid, Sodium Hydrolyzed Potato Starch Dodecenylsuccinate, C12-15 Alkyl Lactate, Panthenol, Cocamidopropyl PG-Dimonium Chloride Phosphate, Disodium Tetrapropenyl Succinate, PEG-120 Methyl Glucose Dioleate, Sodium Chloride, Disodium EDTA, Citric Acid, Sodium Hydroxide, Tocopherol, Benzalkonium Chloride, Parfum. Manufacturer warns product/ingredients may change; physical package label remains authoritative.

The UK manufacturer page declares 2% salicylic acid and reports 97% noticed fewer new spots in four weeks, based on clinical grading in 34 subjects. Full protocol, control and absolute change are not disclosed in the reviewed page. This is not a 97% acne cure rate and is not proof that the physical target unit is UK-market.

UK source page directions: wet face, massage gently, avoid eyes and mouth, rinse; page mentions twice-daily use. These are source-page instructions only and must not replace the physical package directions for the unconfirmed target unit.

products.identity: Garnier Vitamin C Brightening Gel Cleanser; 200 ml Australia source-page version
identity_limits: Australia is source-page market, not confirmed physical-unit market
Current package INCI may differ; package label authoritative

assertions.claim: The Australian manufacturer says the rinse-off gel cleanser gently cleanses, purifies, brightens and boosts skin glow. Its Vitamin C claim is specifically identified as Vitamin Cg (Ascorbyl Glucoside).

Australian manufacturer-page INCI snapshot: AQUA/WATER, SODIUM LAURETH SULFATE, COCO-BETAINE, SODIUM CHLORIDE, GLYCERIN, CITRUS LEMON FRUIT EXTRACT / LEMON FRUIT EXTRACT, PPG5-CETETH-20, SODIUM HYDROXIDE, ASCORBYL GLUCOSIDE, CITRIC ACID, PANTHENOL, POLYQUATERNIUM-7, TOCOPHERYL ACETATE, SODIUM BENZOATE, SALICYLIC ACID, LINALOOL, LIMONENE, BENZYL SALICYLATE, PARFUM / FRAGRANCE. Manufacturer says ingredient lists may change and package label should be checked.

Manufacturer positioning is a rinse-off Vitamin C brightening gel cleanser. No product-specific clinical endpoint establishing acne, comedone or pigmentation treatment was verified in the research ledger.
Manufacturer directions: apply twice daily to wet skin, massage gently over the face and rinse off. Physical package directions remain authoritative.

assertions.claim: The manufacturer positions the international/European formula as SPF50+ PA++++ UV protection with a lightweight serum-like texture and a dewy finish. These claims apply to the cited international page/formula only.

International/Korean manufacturer-page INCI snapshot: Water, Dibutyl Adipate, Propanediol, Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate, Polymethylsilsesquioxane, Ethylhexyl Triazone, Methylene Bis-Benzotriazolyl Tetramethylbutylphenol, Niacinamide, Coco-Caprylate/Caprate, Caprylyl Methicone, Diethylhexyl Butamido Triazone, Glycerin, 1,2-Hexanediol, Butylene Glycol, Pentylene Glycol, Behenyl Alcohol, Poly C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate, Polyglyceryl-3 Methylglucose Distearate, Decyl Glucoside, Tromethamine, Carbomer, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Sodium Stearoyl Glutamate, Polyacrylate Crosspolymer-6, Ethylhexylglycerin, Adenosine, Xanthan Gum, Centella Asiatica Extract, t-Butyl Alcohol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Betula Platyphylla Japonica Bark Extract, Tocopherol, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Ginkgo Biloba Leaf Extract, Brassica Oleracea Italica (Broccoli) Sprout Extract, Camellia Japonica Leaf Extract, Eruca Sativa Leaf Extract, Medicago Sativa (Alfalfa) Extract, Triticum Vulgare (Wheat) Sprout Extract, Inositol, Hyaluronic Acid. The manufacturer identifies this international/Korean version as SPF50+ PA++++. Product-specific independent RCT evidence for this exact formula has not been established in the reviewed dossier. Do not merge with the separate US Water-Fit Sun Serum UV drug-label formula.

Manufacturer directions: at the last step of basic skincare, apply evenly to UV-exposed areas such as face, neck, arms and legs. Follow the physical package for quantity and reapplication instructions.

identity_limits: Mexico official page is the research source; exact target package/market/formula match UNKNOWN
Do not import Spot Prevent data or EU/IT formula details
No ingredient-role assertion is staged because the exact source-matched INCI is not established for this Product record.

assertions.claim: The UK manufacturer positions the product as SPF50+ protection that helps clarify and unify skin tone and helps reduce and prevent pigmentation spots caused by the sun. Results and timing are manufacturer claims only.

Manufacturer positioning is high-protection sunscreen with a cosmetic spot/uneven-tone positioning. The disclosed 31-subject endpoints remain manufacturer-reported; no independent exact-SKU study was verified.

The Mexico manufacturer page reports a 22% reduction in spot intensity and a 15% reduction in spot area in 31 subjects aged 35–65 after 28 and 84 days. The public source does not disclose the full protocol, control, blinding, instruments, statistical analysis or original report. These are manufacturer-reported results, not independently verified proof and not transferable to ISDIN Spot Prevent.

UK manufacturer directions: apply in the morning and at midday; reapply every two hours and as often as necessary. The page also recommends three months for best results. Treat this as source-page guidance, subject to the physical package.

assertions.claim: The official Anua product page displays manufacturer-reported survey outcomes: 90% agreed there was a reduction in skin redness and 90% agreed the appearance of red troubled spots improved after use. The public page does not disclose the sample, comparator, validated endpoint or statistical report. This remains a manufacturer claim, not independently verified efficacy.
assertions.notes: The source is the exact official product page for the serum, not a separate routine page. The manufacturer-displayed survey result remains unverified because the public page does not disclose the protocol.

assertions.claim: Official US serum-page ingredient declaration includes Azelaic Acid, Panthenol, Betaine Salicylate, Glycerin, Allantoin, Niacinamide, Centella-related ingredients, Sodium Hyaluronate, Squalane, Zinc PCA and Ceramide NP. This is a partial source-bound ingredient summary, not a complete verbatim INCI; the full package INCI remains UNKNOWN until matched to a physical label.

The manufacturer declares 10% azelaic acid for this serum and labels testing as non-comedogenic/low-irritation. The public page does not disclose complete methodology for those test labels. Do not infer clinical treatment of acne, rosacea, PIH or persistent redness from ingredient presence or these labels.

Manufacturer advises gradual introduction, beginning 1–2 times weekly and increasing as tolerated (up to twice daily per the source-page routine guidance), with daytime SPF use. Physical package directions remain authoritative.
